title: Qualify immutable private NuGet publisher for dependent Math Expression package in a disposable feed
commitMessage: test: qualify Expression immutable local NuGet publisher rehearsal

contribution.summary: Qualify a Math Expression local-release controller against a real linked-source dependent package in a disposable NuGet feed, without writing to NUGET_LOCAL.
contribution.value: Reuse the published Dw.Tools.NuGet no-overwrite publisher with an exact dw.quantities dependency, verify archive/DLL identity, collisions, digest and cancellation refusals, and run six source-free binary checks.
debtChanges: RS139 qualifies only a disposable release rehearsal. Real NUGET_LOCAL publication requires a separate explicit owner action with the original exact RS138 archive.
An independently rebuilt rehearsal package may have different bytes from RS138; never treat its SHA as the original candidate or change an existing version.
Package notices and inherited rights remain private-only; no open-source license, installed-package rollback, crash recovery or other-OS support is newly qualified.
The already published base dw.quantities and original RS134-RS138 source/evidence remain unchanged; dw.quantities.standard cannot advance until Expression is independently published.
contribution.nextAction: After RS139 is durably pushed and physical RS138 bytes are verified, explicitly invoke the guarded --publish then --verify modes for Expression; qualify published readback under DWF before advancing standard units.
